def append_training_log_file(job_id: int, message: str) -> None:
    path = training_log_path(job_id)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as fp:
        fp.write(f"{_now_iso()} {message}\n")
